I’ve fixed the build error, but I couldn’t compile it here (this sandbox can’t reach the .NET SDK downloads or NuGet), so run-all.sh on your machine is the real test.

Cause: Razor always generates components as public classes, and their [Parameter] properties have to be public. CommentItem, FieldInput and ListingCard had parameters of type Entry, ListingField and Listing, which are all internal. C# doesn’t allow a public property to have a less accessible type.

Fix: the components now only take parameters of public types, and the domain types stay internal. I didn’t make the domain types public instead, because that would spread to FieldValue, ListingSource and FieldKind. It would also likely set off public-API analyzer warnings, such as CA1515 and CA1056, which your warnings-as-errors build would turn into failures.

CommentItem now takes Id (a Guid) and Text (a string?).
FieldInput now takes FieldKey and looks up the field itself with ListingFields.Find. If the key is unknown, it renders nothing.
ListingCard now takes HomeKey, Title, Place, Summary, Sources, CommentCount and Updated.
Pages: HomesPage and ListingPage call the components with the new parameters. The HTML they produce is unchanged, so the JS view modules and E2E selectors are unaffected.
Docs: ADR 0002 now records the rule that component parameters use public types only.
Extract the archive at the repo root. It contains only the changed files, and nothing needs deleting:

docs/adr/0002-rendering-model.md
src/Nest.Web/Components/Shared/CommentItem.razor
src/Nest.Web/Components/Shared/FieldInput.razor
src/Nest.Web/Components/Shared/ListingCard.razor
src/Nest.Web/Components/Pages/HomesPage.razor
src/Nest.Web/Components/Pages/ListingPage.razor

# nest status (2026-11-05)

Repo: https://github.com/kusl/nest, site: https://nest.velixir.run/. Built from the chaos-velixir-run dump.

Delivered: full project as nest.tar.gz (src/Nest.Web, tests/Nest.Web.Tests, tests/Nest.E2E, tests/js, tests/fixtures, scripts, docs/adr 0001-0020).

Design in one line: immutable entries (link, fact, comment) with server UUIDv7 ids, each carrying listing keys (zillow, redfin, realtor, address, url hash); union-find over keys merges homes; newest fact value wins; ids-first handshake (Join snapshot of ids, Fetch missing, Offer what server lacks).

Fixes:
- CS0053 in Shared components (public Razor classes exposing internal Entry/Listing/ListingField). Components now take only public-typed parameters; FieldInput resolves its field by key via ListingFields.Find. Rule recorded in ADR 0002. Delivered as nest-fix-cs0053.tar.gz.

- Deploy needs repository variable VELIXIR_APP_ID in addition to the VELIXIR_API_KEY secret.
